{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|You're allotted one hour a week to get things off your chest-or to 'up-chuck gizzard trichobezoars,' as the Toydarians so colorfully put it.|The [[Equani]] psychiatrist [[Klo Merit]] explains Toydarians description of his services.|<ref name="MS:BS" />}}
'''Trichobezoars''' were objects which could be found in members of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] gizzards. Toydarians were able to vomit up Trichobezoars and compared speaking to a [[psychiatrist]] to throwing the objects up.<ref name="MS:BS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trichobezoars were first mentioned in the novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and released in [[2004]].
